beats.headline: The management apologises
beats.text: Astrid. Bloodlust Sprite, level 125, Cardiovascular Mage, assistant manager of the Desperado Club. The Bloodlust Sprite is one of the rarest and deadliest things her kind produces, born holding magic over anything with a circulatory system, and the signature trick is a heart beating fast enough to catch fire. She is the size of your hand, she wears a tuxedo, her hair is up in a bun, and her voice is deeper than yours. A crawler makes an attempt on Princess Donut on club grounds and Astrid comes down to say sorry in person. The Royal Court walks out with permanent complimentary security. Establishments like this one do not hand out refunds. She handed one out.

beats.headline: Blood set to boil
beats.text: Assistant manager Astrid, level 125, Bloodlust Sprite, adept in cardiovascular magic, locates crawlers on the Hunting Grounds level where management has said they are not permitted. She does not open the door. She sets Crawler Carl's blood to boil through it and suggests he open it if he wishes to be allowed back into the club. The door is opened. His skin is bubbling and his health is falling. She was not trying to kill him. If she had been, he would already be dead.

beats.headline: A name on a slip of skin
beats.text: New entry in the file, and not one the subject would enjoy. The Night Wyrm has issued a guild job, owned by Crawler Katia Grim: kill Astrid, level 125 Bloodlust Sprite, assistant manager of the Desperado Club and owner of the Naughty Boys Employment Agency. Proof of death required. The Wyrm's stated grievance is that she keeps its family in the ground and its blood dry. The contractor has enlisted Carl, whose tattoo lets him read the skin the job is written on. Saying the details out loud cancels the contract.

beats.headline: A contract on the management
beats.text: There is a job out on her, and Crawler Katia Grim has taken it. The preparation is thorough, which is the compliment: Samantha parked at the bar to make noise, Katia getting herself ready, Carl setting traps down the service corridor they expect the assistant manager to walk. Nobody in the building tells her. That is the arrangement everyone employed here works under, and she has known it longer than any of them.

beats.headline: She goes to meet the demon instead
beats.text: The distraction runs too hot, reaches the casino floor, and pulls Minge out of one of the doors to the Nothing. A minor feral demon on the premises during business hours. Astrid does not go anywhere near a service exit. She finds Carl, tells him she is releasing the Vorpals to put the thing down, and tells him to get everyone out. And while the floor empties she says two things: that she has children, and that her husband is the Night Wyrm.

beats.headline: The contract closes
beats.text: Astrid, assistant manager of the Desperado Club, is dead, in the club kitchen. She had put herself between Crawler Carl and a troll that came through the door, which is loyalty to the wrong party. Crawler Carl then ripped off her wings, a crow with a child's skull for a head took her eyes, and Crawler Katia put a spike through her head. Before it, she asked Carl to tell her husband she had done it to keep them safe: him, and their children. Her last words were that she was almost done.

beats.headline: Whose mother she was
beats.text: Two of the dancers out of the Penis Parade are sitting in the strip club crying, and here is why. Damascus Steel and Anaconda are her sons. Everything an assistant manager's influence is worth had been spent quietly, for years, keeping those two off the record and out of anyone's way. Her husband ordered the contract. Damascus wants every dancer in the Parade hired on as a mercenary where it is safe, and after that he wants his father.
